description: This file defines an API client class 'ApiClient' that interacts with a backend server to handle authentication and authorized requests. It manages access tokens, refresh tokens, and request retries upon token expiration, using the Dio HTTP client in Dart.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A Dio-based client for interacting with a REST API, handling token-based authentication, token refresh logic, and request retries.

methods.name: ApiClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Dio client with base URL, timeout, headers, and interceptors for request enhancement and error handling for token refresh.

methods.name: _refreshTokensSerialized
methods.description: Handles serializing token refresh requests to avoid concurrent token refreshes, updates tokens upon success.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by posting username and password, returns token response.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Performs token refresh request with a refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by invalidating the refresh token.
